def delete_one(con, tab, rng):
    """Delete a single sampled row by value match. Returns True if exactly one went."""
    cols = [d[0] for d in con.execute(f'SELECT * FROM "{tab[0]}"."{tab[1]}" LIMIT 0').description]
    row = con.execute(f'SELECT * FROM "{tab[0]}"."{tab[1]}" USING SAMPLE 1 ROWS').fetchone()
    if row is None: return False
    preds = []
    for c, v in zip(cols, row):
        if v is None: preds.append(f'"{c}" IS NULL')
        else:
            lit = str(v).replace("'", "''")
            preds.append(f'"{c}" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM \'{lit}\'')
    n = con.execute(f'SELECT count(*) FROM "{tab[0]}"."{tab[1]}" WHERE {" AND ".join(preds)}').fetchone()[0]
    if n != 1: return False
    con.execute(f'DELETE FROM "{tab[0]}"."{tab[1]}" WHERE {" AND ".join(preds)}')
    return True

def qirana_from_edges(edges, n):
    cov = np.array([float(len(e)) for e in edges]); frac = cov/n
    sh = np.zeros(len(edges))
    for i,kk in enumerate(cov.astype(int)):
        probs = ([ (n-kk)/n ] if n-kk>0 else []) + [1.0/n]*int(kk)
        p = np.array(probs); sh[i] = float(-(p*np.log2(p)).sum())
    return {"qirana_weighted_coverage":cov, "qirana_uniform_gain":frac, "qirana_shannon":sh}

AM = pd.read_csv("results/all_markets_runs.csv"); okm = AM[AM.status=="ok"].copy()
per = okm.groupby(["market","mechanism"])[["revenue_norm","welfare_norm","served","mono_violation_rate"]].mean().reset_index()
piv_r = per.pivot(index="market", columns="mechanism", values="revenue_norm")
piv_w = per.pivot(index="market", columns="mechanism", values="welfare_norm")
inf_mech = ["qirana_weighted_coverage","querymarket_viewcover"]
flat = ["uniform","chawla_ubp"]
rev_flat_wins = (piv_r[flat].max(axis=1) > piv_r[inf_mech].max(axis=1)).sum()
wel_info_wins = (piv_w[inf_mech].max(axis=1) > piv_w[flat].max(axis=1)).sum()
n = len(piv_r)
print(f"markets: {n}")
print(f"flat/UBP beats the information-proportional ports on REVENUE:  {rev_flat_wins}/{n} markets")
print(f"information-proportional ports beat flat/UBP on WELFARE:       {wel_info_wins}/{n} markets")
g = okm.groupby("mechanism")[["revenue_norm","welfare_norm"]].agg(["mean","std"]).round(3)
print("\n", g.to_string())
mk = okm.groupby("market")[["assets","pairs","falsified","zero_priced"]].first()
mk["falsified_rate"] = mk.falsified/mk.pairs.replace(0,np.nan)
mk["zero_priced_frac"] = mk.zero_priced/mk.assets
mk.to_csv("results/all_markets_structure.csv")
print(f"\nfalsified edges: total {int(mk.falsified.sum())} of {int(mk.pairs.sum())} pairs "
      f"({mk.falsified.sum()/mk.pairs.sum():.4f}) | markets with at least one: {int((mk.falsified>0).sum())}/{n}")
print(f"zero-priced assets at |S|=300: median {mk.zero_priced_frac.median():.3f}, "
      f"range {mk.zero_priced_frac.min():.3f} to {mk.zero_priced_frac.max():.3f}")
